answer: Seven neighbors from separate clusters co-sign each newcomer, locking 25 credits each in a shared bond on a crystal-clear ledger. If it proves fake, the bond burns and all seven lose their stake. 1,000 fakes need 7,000 sponsors, 175,000 credits for a 40,000 pool. One fake sends a ripple through its quorum, freezing its sponsors. Rented sponsors fail: each vouch leaves a relic. An honest agent needs seven neighbors once, keeps its full share.
